linters have been updated for adapting golang 1.18.

> What are the benefits apart from using a new cool feature?
> 
> Have you done any benchmarking if the generics are faster in this case?

1、The main purpose is to strengthen the base library and remove duplicate code. so I disagree that generics can be used everywhere in the TiDB repo.  Golang's generics are not very mature, so we'd better just use them simply to gain experience.

2、I have add the benchmark. Here is the benchmark code.

```
package main

import (
	"math/rand"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func BenchmarkMaxGenerics(b *testing.B) {
	rand.Seed(time.Now().Unix())
	for n := 0; n < b.N; n++ {
		Max(1, rand.Perm(10)...) // run fib(30) b.N times
	}
}

func BenchmarkMax(b *testing.B) {
	rand.Seed(time.Now().Unix())
	for n := 0; n < b.N; n++ {
		MinInt(1, rand.Perm(10)...) // run fib(30) b.N times
	}
}

```

Here is the result.

```
> $ go test -bench=. -benchtime=5s -count=3 .                                                                                                                     
goos: darwin
goarch: amd64
pkg: gomain
cpu: Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-9880H CPU @ 2.30GHz
BenchmarkMaxGenerics-16         23212767               256.9 ns/op
BenchmarkMaxGenerics-16         23165785               258.9 ns/op
BenchmarkMaxGenerics-16         22609570               281.8 ns/op
BenchmarkMax-16                 20863150               294.3 ns/op
BenchmarkMax-16                 20165695               302.9 ns/op
BenchmarkMax-16                 19426915               309.4 ns/op
PASS
ok      gomain  38.443s
```

It seems that the generic one has better performance. In fact, They should have the same performance.

```
> $ go test -bench=. -benchtime=10s .                                                                                                                             
goos: darwin
goarch: amd64
pkg: gomain
cpu: Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-9880H CPU @ 2.30GHz
BenchmarkMaxGenerics-16         34395898               346.1 ns/op
BenchmarkMax-16                 34346350               342.2 ns/op
PASS
ok      gomain  24.556s
```

update benchmark result. Their performance is about the same.
